cryptoLibraries: Java Cryptography Architecture providers bundled with Java 17: MessageDigest SHA-256, Mac HmacSHA256 (PBKDF2 primitive), Cipher AES/GCM/NoPadding
syntheticCredentialMechanism: Direct test-only passphrase supplied in conformance/vectors.json at fixtureRecovery.testOnlyPassphrase

ambiguities.specificationText: RECOVERY-SPEC.md section 7.1 says the historical current-writer order begins with originalContentHash.
competingInterpretations: Parse metadata by field name regardless of order.
ambiguities.resolution: Non-blocking: section 7.1 explicitly says readers MUST parse by field name and MUST NOT require order, so the second interpretation is normative for recovery.

postRunRecordAmendment.reason: Corrected the crypto library inventory from the initially planned SecretKeyFactory PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 to the actually implemented byte-oriented Mac HmacSHA256 PBKDF2 primitive. No recovery parameters, source evidence, ambiguity assessment, or test result changed.
